contract: POST /api/backups/upload is admin-only. It accepts only a .audiobookshelf body with a details entry (max 1 MiB, four lines, non-empty serverVersion) and absdatabase.sqlite, answers 200 with only backups, and rejects no-file (500), wrong extension (500), non-zip (400), missing database (500), missing/oversized details (400), missing version (500) and traversal entries (400) leaving no file behind. Re-uploading an id replaces its entry.
exceptions: force is not applicable: upload has no force or overwrite flag; an existing id is replaced by the same request path.
Named Go tests remain assertion leads for the Go implementation; the scenario refs are the black-box proof.

invariants.contract: A valid upload answers 200 with only a backups array naming the archive with its details id, key, serverVersion, createdAt, filename as uploaded, path backups/<filename>, fullPath under the backup path and fileSize equal to the stored file; a later GET reflects the re-uploaded details; 403/401 for non-admin and anonymous callers.
exceptions: Named tests listed are relevant package-level current tests; their assertions do not yet prove every route branch or the complete upstream contract.

invariants.contract: Uploading an id that is already listed replaces that one entry (single list entry, single file) and its fileSize matches the newer upload.
exceptions: Current test names are discovery anchors; repeated-operation outputs need explicit assertion mapping.

invariants.contract: Upload rejects a missing file part or a file under another field (500), wrong extension (500), non-zip (400), missing absdatabase.sqlite (500), missing details (400), details over 1 MiB (400), details without serverVersion (500), a zip entry that traverses with ../ (400) and a move that cannot enter a read-only backup directory (500); each rejection leaves no list entry, no file in the backup directory and no file outside it.
